subject: Change default number of tiles in stat_density2d

messages.author: bc2b61f4e85b77c0
messages.subject: Change default number of tiles in stat_density2d
parts:
I'd like to change the number of tiles or bins. It appears 100 is the default.

I've tried this:

c + stat_density2d(geom="tile", aes(fill = ..density..), bins = .05, contour = FALSE) + xlim(1,10) + ylim(1,10) 
c + stat_density2d(geom="tile", aes(fill = ..density..), binwidth = .05, contour = FALSE) + xlim(1,10) + ylim(1,10) 

But neither changes the plot. Any ideas?

Thanks.

messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: Re: Change default number of tiles in stat_density2d
parts:
Hi Kenton,

It looks like "n" works to indicate the number of bins ...

ggplot(mtcars,aes(carb,gear))+stat_density2d(geom="tile",aes(fill=..density..),n=10,contour=FALSE)


HTH,
